elaine: hey — heads up: the new sampleapp onboarding has a pretty bad telemetry leak when you enable DEBUG logs. req IDs are showing in plaintext in a few stacks even though redact=on in config. anyone seen this? :eyes:

ben: ugh. can you paste a sample log line and your env config?

elaine: sure. repro steps: start sampleapp with NODE_ENV=development, set REDWOOD_REDACT=true, then hit /generate with retry middleware enabled. log snippet: ```INFO 2026-03-23 request=req_7f8a2c3a user=alice prompt="translate" tokens=32``` — the request= value should be redacted.

omar: hmm, looks like the retry middleware re-attaches headers and the logger picks up the raw header before otel/redact hook runs. We saw similar in Node async init races. Are you initializing OpenTelemetry after the logger?

elaine: this is the sampleapp default — logger init happens in lib/logger.js which is required by express index.js before opentelemetry init in telemetry/init.js.

ben: yeah that's our problem. If logger binds a format function before the otel hook is installed, redact won't run on structured fields. quick fix: ensure otel/redact hooks are installed synchronously at startup, before any logger registration.

elaine: trying a quick local patch: moved require('./telemetry/init') to the very top of index.js and made init() sync. will test.

devex-bot: FYI docs guide: https://playbook.redwood.ai/devex/telemetry#initialization-order — recommends installing scrubbers before logger.

omar: also check retry middleware flow — it clones headers on retry and we had a bug where cloned header kept original reqid string in a different property (x-rw-reqid-raw) that the redact hook wasn't watching. We should normalize header names and run scrub on clone.

ben: good catch. We should add a small unit test: simulate retry and assert redact("request") output is "[REDACTED]" in logs.

elaine: wrote a quick test and failing. patch incoming: https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/842 — it changes startup order and patches retry header clone to run redactHook(headerClone).

ops-bot: build passed on linux, flake on mac (timeout), re-run? :thumbsup:

omar: re: mac flake — unrelated, looks like an integration timeout. ignoring for now, merging the runtime fix is higher priority.

ben: after merging, we should update the quickstart README to call out the sync init for telemetry in JS/TS sampleapps and add a troubleshooting blurb about reqid leakage and retry clones.

elaine: PR merged, validated locally — DEBUG logs no longer contain raw req IDs. :tada:

ben: awesome. can you add a short migration note on the SDK breaking change (init ordering) so users don't get surprised?

elaine: will do. closing this thread once I add the README note. thanks y'all. :white_check_mark:
